title: First save of the lab in git
author: claude
summary: The lab's work was saved in git for the first time.
what: We saved the lab in git for the first time: the app, the Blender scripts, the baked room files and the CONTEXT.md notes.
why: A clean starting point to compare the evening-mood work against.
how: One save (commit), called 'First commit' (`0f19f9a`, 2026-11-26 13:00). Work after it, such as the evening mood, is not saved yet: we only commit when the user asks.

tech.name: git
tech.plain: Saves the project history so any change can be compared or undone.

meta.note: Written afterwards; the time only orders the timeline.
